decisions.reason: The classic CIFAR-10 LCNet050 notebook's saved AUC table shows CLASSIC_CVA micro-AUC mean = 0.962411, matching si_value 0.9624; the extraction already holds the classic macro-AUC (0.9578) for the same config, so the micro-AUC is a genuine additional metric of the paper's own study.

The full/hybrid CIFAR-10 LCNet050 notebook's saved AUC table shows HYBRID_Y_W4_S1 micro-AUC mean = 0.957638, matching si_value 0.9576; the extraction already holds the hybrid macro-AUC (0.9531) for the same config, so the micro-AUC is a genuine additional metric.
